d: Messy, voluminous olive-green hair is styled with wild curls and a single prominent cowlick atop the head. Small, narrow olive-green eyes peer through thin-rimmed glasses on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and lithe, wearing a brown leather jacket with a white fur collar over a yellow-and-white striped turtleneck and a white button-down shirt layered with various papers. Light-blue flared denim jeans are worn, featuring pink lettering on the thigh and numerous pieces of paper tucked into the legs, paired with brown leather boots. Accessories include a small brown crossbody satchel, a large olive-drab canvas backpack overflowing with rolled scrolls and white roses, and a small green notebook held in one hand.
